---
title: "Model Profiles"
---

Model profiles are non-secret model/provider defaults written into `.agents/models.yml` in generated repositories.

Profile names are stable handles. `.repo-familiar/bootstrap.yml` records selected profile names under `selected_options.model_profiles`, while `.agents/models.yml` stores the runtime details agents should read.

## Current Profiles

`default-coding`:

```yaml
provider: openai
model: gpt-5.5
use: general coding and repository maintenance
harnesses:
  - opencode
notes:
  latency: medium
  cost: high
  strengths:
    - codebase editing
    - documentation
```

`budget-review`:

```yaml
provider: anthropic
model: claude-sonnet-4-5
use: cheaper review and planning passes
harnesses:
  - opencode
notes:
  latency: medium
  cost: medium
```

## Rules

- Keep provider secrets out of `.agents/models.yml`.
- Keep profile names stable once generated repositories may reference them.
- Prefer pragmatic fields over fully normalized provider metadata until templates require more structure.
- Record selected profile names in bootstrap metadata for provenance and future upgrades.
